_base: Make one 16:9 video using the attached image as the exact first frame (image-to-video, Veo 3.1 Lite, 1 output, 8 seconds). Gentle, playful cartoon animation of this exact picture from my own game. STRICT RULES: only the characters already in the picture move; every character keeps exactly the same design, shape, colours and size and stays roughly in place; nobody new appears, nobody leaves, nothing turns into anything else; the camera stays still or pushes in very slowly. FACES: these food monsters have only eyes and a mouth exactly as drawn in the first frame; never add a nose, nostrils, a snout or any human facial features, and keep each face the same shape. {X} No text, no speech or dialogue, no scene cut.
cut-open: Candle flames flicker, the golden spoon glows and twinkles, the three kaiju in front stay in place, slowly lick their lips, glance at each other with scheming grins, then look back at the spoon; the camera pushes in very slowly. Playful sneaky heist music.
cut-0: The crab kaiju snaps its claws grumpily twice and stomps its little feet on the roast chicken, steam curls up from the gravy boat. Comedic grumpy music with snip-snip sound effects.
cut-1: The octopus juggles the cutlery in a smooth loop with its tentacles, the green jelly blob wobbles and jiggles happily beside it. Bouncy comedic music with clinks and boings.
cut-2: The fridge light flickers softly, the toast bat sways gently upside down from the shelf and flaps its wings once, the marshmallow moth wiggles its antennae and wings in the takeaway box with a small closed-mouth smile. Spooky-funny music and a fridge hum.
cut-3: The conveyor belt keeps rolling gently, the crowned sushi dragon smirks and waves one claw like a king, the salmon bodyguard crosses its fins and nods. Cool swaggering music.
cut-4: The elephant's pink bubblegum bubble slowly grows bigger and then pops with a splat, the chocolate golem freezes mid-bite with wide eyes and frosting on its cheeks, a little confetti flutters down. Silly party music with a pop sound.
cut-5: The pizza raptor and the avocado kaiju stare each other down, the raptor twirls its pizza cutter, the avocado narrows its eyes, a tiny tumbleweed-like crumb rolls between them. Dramatic standoff music with comedic timing.
cut-6: The muffin bear flips a pancake up and catches it in the pan, the griddle flames flicker, steam and sizzle rise, the cheese crab and the toast bat at the counter tap their claws impatiently and blink. Sizzling sounds, a ding-ding order bell and fast diner jazz.
cut-7: The giant crowned green jelly dome only wobbles and jiggles in place like jelly and narrows its eyes, keeping its grumpy closed-mouth frown; it stays one smooth dome with no arms, hands or lumps. A little frost creeps along the counter, the milkshake drips, the marshmallow moth in front blinks nervously and gulps. Camera stays still. Ominous-but-silly boss music.
cut-8: The sloth sways slowly from the straw and gives a big lazy yawn, the ants keep marching in their line, the avocado and the salmon relax on the blanket and blink, leaves sway in the breeze. Cheerful lazy summer music.
cut-9: The dumpling kaiju kneads and slaps the big ball of dough, little puffs of flour float up, the dough swells slightly, the muffin bear and chocolate golem watch nervously and blink. Thumping comedic villain music.
cut-10: The lazy Susan turns slowly round with the happy hot-dog hedgehog riding it in the middle, its ketchup and mustard spikes wobbling, the sushi dragon and bubblegum elephant sway dizzily. Merry-go-round music.
cut-11: Only the environment moves: warm morning sunlight shimmers, steam curls gently from the coffee and pancakes, syrup slowly drips, and the golden spoon glints with a little sparkle. The three kaiju stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes; the crowned dumpling smiles a little wider with its mouth closed. The camera pushes in very slowly. Epic but silly final-boss music.
cut-end: Confetti drifts down, the five kaiju cheer and bounce gently in place, the single golden spoon sparkles, the tall tower of dirty dishes wobbles and one plate slides off with a clang. Triumphant fanfare ending in a comedic sad trombone.
s2-open: Only the environment moves: the fridge light flickers softly and cold mist drifts along the shelf. The three kaiju stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes once or twice. The camera pushes in very slowly. Quiet playful music.
s2-0: The blender beside them whirs and wobbles, little splashes of smoothie fly, the sloth snores and slowly opens one sleepy eye, the avocado dragon flaps its little wings and giggles; the camera stays still. Relaxed bouncy music, blender whirr.
s2-1: Only the environment moves: the cheese bubbles gently and steam rises, the candle flames flicker. The owl and the chocolate bar stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes. The camera stays still. Warm cosy accordion music.
s2-2: Only the environment moves: syrup slowly drips down the sides of the pancakes and the butter melts a little, steam rises from the mugs. The three kaiju on top stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes. The camera stays still. Cheerful breakfast music.
s2-3: Frost sparkles and a gentle snowfall drifts down, the crowned penguin puffs out its chest and flaps its flippers proudly, the turtle nods, both stay in place; the camera pushes in very slowly. Cool icy royal fanfare music.
s2-4: The bubblegum bubble slowly grows and pops with a soft splat, the jelly blob jiggles and bounces on the gumdrop, the kangaroo chuckles and taps its foot; nobody moves away; the camera stays still. Sugary silly music, pop and boing sounds.
s2-5: Only the environment moves: burner flames flicker and steam rises from the pans. The three kaiju stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes; the crowned kangaroo smiles a little wider. The camera pushes in very slowly. Epic but silly boss music.
s2-end: Only the environment moves: confetti drifts down gently and the two golden spoons sparkle. The three kaiju stay completely still in their exact poses and only blink their eyes and smile. The camera stays still. Happy triumphant fanfare.
